chapters.1.meaning: Joshua must follow God’s law while leading the people. The eastern tribes must help their neighbors.
chapters.6.meaning: Israel destroys Jericho but keeps its promise to Rahab. Her household survives.
chapters.8.meaning: Victory at Ai leads to a public reading of the law. Both children and strangers hear it.
chapters.10.meaning: Joshua answers Gibeon’s call for help. The chapter includes a poem about the sun and moon.
chapters.11.meaning: Joshua destroys Hazor. Excavated remains show fire damage, but they do not identify who caused it.
chapters.12.meaning: The list gathers the book’s victories into one record. It names kings east and west of the Jordan.
chapters.14.meaning: Caleb asks for the land promised to him. He recalls remaining faithful when the other scouts feared Canaan.
chapters.16.meaning: Ephraim receives land but leaves Canaanites at Gezer. The people there become forced workers.
chapters.17.meaning: Zelophehad’s daughters receive their promised land. Joseph’s tribes must clear forests instead of seeking an easier share.
chapters.23.summary: Joshua warns Israel’s leaders about worshiping other gods. He urges them to keep God’s covenant.
people.joseph.meaning: Joseph’s descendants receive land through Ephraim and Manasseh. His name joins the two tribes.
people.judah.meaning: Judah’s tribe receives land in the south. Caleb’s family settles within this area.
people.reuben.meaning: Reuben’s tribe receives land east of the Jordan. Its warriors must help the other tribes.
people.simeon.meaning: Simeon’s tribe receives towns within Judah’s share. Judah’s land is too large for its own needs.
people.levi.meaning: Levi’s tribe receives towns among the other tribes. Priestly service takes the place of one large territory.
people.benjamin.meaning: Benjamin’s tribe receives land between Judah and Joseph’s tribes. Its town list includes Jerusalem.
people.ephraim.meaning: Ephraim’s tribe receives land west of the Jordan. The book notes Canaanites remaining at Gezer.
people.manasseh.meaning: Manasseh’s descendants receive land on both sides of the Jordan. Zelophehad’s daughters receive a share.
people.zebulun.meaning: Zebulun’s tribe receives its towns and borders by lot at Shiloh.
people.issachar.meaning: Issachar’s tribe receives towns that include Shunem. Its border reaches the Jordan.
people.dan.meaning: Dan’s tribe receives towns but struggles to hold its land. It later takes Leshem.
people.naphtali.meaning: Naphtali’s tribe receives northern towns that include Hazor and Kedesh.
people.gad.meaning: Gad’s tribe receives land east of the Jordan. Its warriors help the western tribes.
people.asher.meaning: Asher’s tribe receives land near the northern coast. Its town list reaches toward Sidon.
people.achan.meaning: Achan hides goods taken from Jericho. His confession explains Israel’s earlier defeat at Ai.
people.adoni-zedek.meaning: Adoni Zedek gathers kings to attack Gibeon after it makes peace with Israel.
people.piram.meaning: Piram joins four other kings against Gibeon. Joshua defeats their forces.
